CHAPTER.VERS: The declaration of Yahweh to my LordSit thou at my right hand, Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
Thy sceptre of strength, will Yahweh extend out of Zion, Tread thou down, in the midst of thy foes.
Thy people, will freely offer themselves, in the day of thine army,in the splendours of holiness, out of the womb of the dawn, To thee, the dew of thy youth.
Yahweh, hath swornand will not repent, Thou,
My Lord, on thy right hand,hath shatteredin the day of his angerkings;
He will judge among the nationsfull of dead bodies! He hath shattered the head over a land far extended:
